title: Advantage-point balance gate

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1690878 (0x0019ccfe), HLP file offset 428787 (0x00068af3), topic 247 'Custom Race Wizard'
provenance.note: Balance must be greater than or equal to zero before Finish.

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1804225 (0x001b87c1), HLP file offset 456118 (0x0006f5b6), topic 268 'Step 3: Lesser Traits (Player Race)'
provenance.note: Lesser traits can restore a negative balance; Finish requires zero or above.

setup.baseline: Neutral custom race with no advantages or disadvantages.
setup.variable: Add or remove one trait/field choice at a time and record the advantage-point balance.

procedure: Record the baseline balance on each wizard page.
Add one advantage and record the exact balance change.
Add one disadvantage and record the exact balance change.
Drive the balance negative and confirm Finish is blocked; return to zero and confirm Finish is allowed.
Repeat with a different starting baseline to detect non-linear or interaction costs.

documented: The finish gate is a non-negative advantage-point balance (documented-only).
The wizard displays the current unused balance in the upper-right corner (documented-only).

unresolved: No exact point costs or formulas were recovered.
Whether the gate uses integer points and how rounding works is unknown.
